problems: The validator reports nine 'Cliopatria shape han_-404 ... han_-203 has no verdict' warnings on han-2 because slugify('Hán') is 'han'; those shapes belong to the ea-01 han dossier, not to han-2. han-2 has 0 errors.

Cross-dossier matches missing in other parts: qi has no gain from jiaodong or jibei in 206; kingdom-of-han has no gain from henan in 205 and no vassal_start for han-2 (205-201); han-dynasty needs gains of linjiang (202) and the Hán lands (201); western-chu's 203 gains from jiujiang and linjiang conflict with this part (Jiujiang falls 204, Linjiang stands to 202).

Wikidata Q5349053 is shared by twelve different kingdoms (Han Cheng, Shen Yang, Tian Fu, Ying Bu, Han Guang, Gong Ao and others); none was merged. han-2 is 'Hán' (Han Cheng), not 'Han' (Warring States, slug han).

Cliopatria years changed: henan ends 205 (row to 204), jiaodong and liaodong end 206 (rows to 204), linjiang runs to 202 and han-2 to 201 (rows end 204). The han-2 extension to 201 rests on the Xin of Han page alone.

Pages are thin for these kingdoms: the Eighteen Kingdoms page gives no capitals or dates; capitals for henan, jiujiang, jiaodong, liaodong are unverified and flagged in the capital notes. Shared pages (Eighteen Kingdoms, Chu-Han Contention, Timeline) plus one or two own pages per state were opened; total distinct pages cited 18, over the 1-2 per state budget for the shared ones.

WebFetch summarises pages through a small model; quotes in the notes are the tool's returned text and some page details (Tian Rong page death year, Zheng Chang page spelling Hán Xin) look inconsistent with other pages; a reviewer should re-open the Timeline, Xin of Han and Zang Tu pages for the key years.
